notes: «سأل علي بن جعفر أخاه» : the asker is not a link when the report is the Imam's answer (rule 5), so only the Imam is read
The Imam is named in the words of the report with no chain: imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
«يعني المسلخ» is an editor's gloss, left out

fixes.reason: RWY reads Ali b. Ja'far as the only link; the text has him as the asker and Musa b. Ja'far as the one who answers

evidence.quote: سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
